overview: A premium dark-navy Indian fintech rewards and membership platform with secure sign-in, seven membership plans, manual UPI payment verification, wallet, referrals, withdrawals and a secure admin console.
features: Secure sign-in with a personal registration profile
Personal dashboard with wallet, rewards, referrals and membership summary
Seven membership plans from ₹150 to ₹9,999 with a highlighted popular plan
Manual UPI payment with QR code, UTR entry and screenshot upload
Admin verification that activates membership and records transactions
Wallet with balances and credit/debit history
Referral system with unique code, share link and ₹199 rewards
UPI and bank withdrawal requests with admin review
Customer support with complaint form and policies
Separate secure admin console for users, payments, withdrawals, plans and referrals
